registered_design.reason: single-clock GPS-only solve avoids unmodelled inter-system biases

summary.initialisation: RINEX approximate XYZ plus first-epoch full-sky SPP
summary.satellite_selection: previous conventional solution; truth used only for scoring
summary.tep_anchor_policy: previous non-jammed full-sky free-clock epoch, frozen throughout outage
summary.tep_activation_policy: fallback only when the conventional free-clock solve is unavailable
summary.local_base_dgps_policy: same-epoch zero-mean satellite residual; base receiver clock removed
summary.inference_unit: one flight; outage windows are correlated stress episodes, not independent flights
